messages:
maya: Heads-up: drafting internal RN for 'smart-batching v1' canary tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need quick review on pinning & rollback lanes. Deploy window 09:00-10:00 PT (16:00-17:00 UTC).

dev-deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled deploy job #dpl-4821 queued for 2026-03-22T16:00:00Z. Will run canary -> ramp -> full. Reply 'ACK' to lock pinning.

sam: :eyes: can you paste the pin matrix? especially for EU region (latency-sensitive customers).

maya: here's the current pinning / fallback draft (will put into the RN doc):
```yaml
pinning:
  us-east-1:
    model: rwlm/batching-v1
    version: v1.2.0
    rollout: canary(5%), 30m -> 25% -> 100%
  eu-west-1:
    model: rwlm/batching-v1
    version: v1.1.9
    rollout: canary(2%), 60m -> 10% -> 50%
fallbacks:
  on_error: revert-to v1.1.8
  metrics_alarm: latency>200ms p95 OR error_rate>1.5%
```

lina: Suggest for eu we keep v1.1.9 pinned for dedicated customers and only include 2% canary for public. Also add 'grace-period' flag for KV-cache warmup (avoid transient tail-latency).

ops-oncall: Rollback plan (short): if p95 latency spike or eval divergence, ops initiates immediate rollback: 1) pause deploybot 2) set routing to fallback version 3) open incident channel (#incident-dpl-4821) 4) announce RN update and customer comms. I'll author a 4-step checklist and attach.

maya: Great — adding checklist. Also need release note blurb for internal announce: short bullets for eng/ops/product. Draft below:
- What: smart-batching runtime change (model batching optimizations + KV cache warming)
- Who it affects: public hosted + dedicated pools (see pinning matrix)
- Window: 09:00-10:00 PT (canary first 30–60m)
- Rollback criteria: p95 latency >200ms, error_rate >1.5%, or eval regression >1%
- Oncall: @ops-oncall, @ryan on standby

ryan: Suggestion: include a 'how this affects customers' line with two examples (short prompts -> faster; long-form generation -> slight memory bump). Also attach eval prompt IDs for traceability.

maya: Attached minimal eval summary: 'eval-suite v2026-03: 200 prompts, BLEU unchanged, hallucination rate +0.6% on long-form -> within threshold'. Will attach the CSV to the RN doc.

kai: ACK from security: no new data exfil flags, KMS rotation verified. Make sure to mark private/enterprise customers in RN as not auto-upgraded.

sam: I'll do the final copyedit and pin the RN draft in the docs repo. Can someone add the snippet for deploybot cue? Format below.

```text
# deploybot cue
cue: deploy dpl-4821
notify: #eng-sre, #product
canary-size: 5%
monitoring: latency_p95, error_rate, sanity_eval
rollback-window: 60m
```

dev-deploy-bot: deploy-bot: received cue template. To lock and schedule, a user must react with :rocket: within this thread.

sam: :rocket: Locking schedule. I'll push RN to /docs/internal/releases/2026-03-22-batching-v1.md and ping ops.

maya: :thumbsup: thanks. ops-oncall — can you post the 4-step rollback checklist here when ready? Also we'll pin this message at 09:00 PT day-of.

ops-oncall: Rollback checklist (compact):
1) pause dpl-4821 in deploy UI (or `deploybot pause dpl-4821`)
2) set traffic routing to fallback v1.1.8 for affected regions (run `routing set --model rwlm/batching-v1 --version v1.1.8 --regions eu-west-1,us-east-1`)
3) run sanity curl checks (examples below) and confirm < 1% error for 5m
4) post incident summary in #incident-dpl-4821 and update RN with rollback note
Sanity curl example: `curl -sS -X POST https://api.prod/redwood/generate -d '{"prompt":"quick test"}'`

ryan: LGTM. I'll be on standby during the window.

lina: Adding a note to RN about EU dedicated customers and config change: 'no change to pinned models for enterprise accounts unless explicitly allowed by customer success.'

maya: Final: merging RN draft in 30m unless objections. Last call.

kai: :eyes: no objections from security.

maya: Merged. I'll post the internal announce at T-15m and pin this thread. Thanks everyone.
